An '''Alderaanian artist''' lived in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], on the fateful day the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] came to [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. While the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] was visible in the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]], the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|woman]] painted the [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] on her balcony. Subsequently, the Death Star's [[Concave Dish Composite Beam Superlaser|superlaser]] [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|reduced]] the entirety of Alderaan to scattered [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] fragments and debris.
